page_title: MON 3-0 SAL | Monza v Salernitana 08/10/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.
90+5' Roberto Gagliardini (Monza) works the corner short.
90+5' Warren Bondo (Monza) works the corner short instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.

90+2' OFF THE BAR! Roberto Gagliardini (Monza) drifts into the box to give his teammate support. He receives a fantastic pass and shoots from close range, but it crashes against the crossbar! It could have been a brilliant goal, unlucky.
90+1' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Lassana Coulibaly (Salernitana) was quite harsh and Luca Massimi didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
90' We will have 5 min. of added time.
88' The resulting set piece from Salernitana is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
87' Salernitana have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
86' The referee signals a substitution. Jean-Daniel Akpa Akpro (Monza) is brought on as a substitute for Matteo Pessina.
84' Papu Gomez (Monza) launches a cross from the corner, but Guillermo Ochoa is alert to thwart the effort.
84' Papu Gomez (Monza) takes the corner which is cleared.
84' Lorenzo Colombo (Monza) gets inside the box and tries to beat Guillermo Ochoa with a measured shot towards the roof of the net, but the keeper is equal to the effort and makes a fine save.
83' Paulo Sousa has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Lassana Coulibaly (Salernitana) replacing Grigoris Kastanos.
82' 3 - 0 GOAL! Matteo Pessina (Monza) strikes the penalty low down the middle and scores after the ball glances off the leg of Guillermo Ochoa.
81' Matteo Pessina (Monza) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.
80' Lorenzo Pirola (Salernitana) touches the ball with his hand. PENALTY to Monza!
79' The foul by Matteo Pessina (Monza) was seen by Luca Massimi who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
78' Papu Gomez (Monza) swings in the corner, but fails to find any of his teammates. One of the defenders reacts superbly to get it clear.
77' Samuele Birindelli pulls the ball back to Lorenzo Colombo (Monza) inside the box, but despite having a clear sight of goal he blasts the ball just past the right post.
75' The resulting corner from Antonio Candreva (Salernitana) is cleared.
75' Antonio Candreva (Salernitana) prepares to take a corner kick.
74' Trivante Stewart (Salernitana) plays a dangerous chip pass into the box in an attempt to set up one of his teammates, but the effort is intercepted by one of the defenders.
72' Raffaele Palladino prepares a substitution. Georgios Kyriakopoulos is replaced by Samuele Birindelli (Monza).
72' The manager makes a subsitution with Warren Bondo (Monza) coming on for Samuele Vignato.
69' Grigoris Kastanos (Salernitana) launches the ball from the resulting corner, but one of the defenders is first to the ball and deals with the threat.
69' Salernitana take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
67' Luca Massimi blows his whistle. Trivante Stewart (Salernitana) commits a foul after dangerous play.
65' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Andrea Colpani trots off the pitch and is replaced by Papu Gomez (Monza).
64' Here is a change. Patrick Ciurria is going off and Raffaele Palladino gives the last tactical orders to Pedro Pereira (Monza).
63' Domagoj Bradaric (Salernitana) receives a yellow card from the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
61' Giulio Maggiore (Salernitana) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Luca Massimi saw the whole situation.
60' It will be a substitution. Trivante Stewart (Salernitana) is ready to enter the pitch as Jovane walks off.
60' Antonio Candreva (Salernitana) is caught offside!
59' The linesman raises his flag for offside before Antonio Candreva (Salernitana) heads on.
58' Jovane (Salernitana) was too forceful with his tackle and Luca Massimi interrupted the game to signal a free kick.
56' Norbert Gyomber (Salernitana) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
55' Jovane (Salernitana) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Luca Massimi blows his whistle for a foul.
54' Norbert Gyomber (Salernitana) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Luca Massimi has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.
54' Grigoris Kastanos (Salernitana) decides to take a short corner instead of crossing into the box.
49' Andrea Colpani (Monza) puts a cross into the box from the corner but there is no panic from the opposition and they easily clear.
47' Antonio Candreva (Salernitana) launches into a thunderous tackle on his opponent and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
46' Domagoj Bradaric (Salernitana) tries to send a pass but it's blocked.
46' Paulo Sousa has made a change at the break. Agustin Martegani has come on in place of Mateusz Legowski (Salernitana).
46' The game is over for Emil Bohinen (Salernitana). Giulio Maggiore comes on for the second half.
46' Half-time substitution. Pasquale Mazzocchi (Salernitana) will not participate anymore and Domagoj Bradaric is coming on.
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+2' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45+1' Luca Massimi blows his whistle and it's Lorenzo Pirola (Salernitana) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
45' The fourth official shows 1 min. of added time.
44' Patrick Ciurria (Monza) steadies himself and bends in a shot from the edge of the box towards the bottom right corner, but Guillermo Ochoa has it covered and makes a comfortable save.
44' Luca Massimi blows his whistle as Luca Caldirola (Monza) used excessive force in the tackle during an attack.
40' Antonio Candreva (Salernitana) sends a long ball in, but Michele Di Gregorio comfortably gathers the ball.
39' Roberto Gagliardini (Monza) manages to dispossess his opponent of the ball, but he commits a foul in the process and the referee blows his whistle.
37' Lorenzo Colombo (Monza) sends in a pass which fails to reach any of his teammates.
36' Georgios Kyriakopoulos (Monza) tries to find Lorenzo Colombo, but he puts too much power on the pass.
34' A great solo run by Lorenzo Colombo (Monza) took him deep inside the box, but his weak effort towards the middle of the goal was easily caught by Guillermo Ochoa.
31' Lorenzo Colombo (Monza) cuts inside after a good run and goes for glory from the edge of the box. The shot, though, flies high over the bar into row Z.
30' Pablo Mari (Monza) makes a rough challenge and Luca Massimi blows his whistle for a foul.
29' What was Samuele Vignato (Monza) thinking? He will not get away with that. The referee shows him a yellow card.
28' Patrick Ciurria (Monza) gets on the ball and beats an opponent, but his run is stopped by the referee Luca Massimi who sees an offensive foul.
26' Flavius Daniliuc (Salernitana) clearly holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee immediately stops play.

25' Samuele Vignato (Monza) bursts into the box after a fine solo run. He looks up and tries to rifle a shot low into the middle of the goal, but Guillermo Ochoa makes a great save to deny him his moment of glory.
24' Luca Massimi interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Grigoris Kastanos (Salernitana).
21' Antonio Candreva (Salernitana) produces a good strike towards the roof of the net, but the goalkeeper shows great reflexes and dives to keep the effort from hitting the net.
21' Pablo Mari (Monza) commits a rough challenge and Luca Massimi blows his whistle for a foul.
20' Georgios Kyriakopoulos (Monza) sends a cross into the box, but Guillermo Ochoa comes off his line to gather the ball.

18' 2 - 0 Goal! Roberto Gagliardini produces a great pass that finds Samuele Vignato (Monza) inside the penalty area, who takes advantage of the situation to rifle a shot into the bottom right corner. 2:0.

18' Andrea Colpani (Monza) gets into a good shooting position. He wins some space for himself and drills a long-range daisy-cutter towards the middle of the goal. His good effort is, however, superbly saved by Guillermo Ochoa!
17' Pasquale Mazzocchi (Salernitana) clearly holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
16' Flavius Daniliuc (Salernitana) makes a rough challenge and the referee blows for a foul.
13' Norbert Gyomber (Salernitana) tackles a bit over-zealously and Luca Massimi blows for a foul.

9' 1 - 0 Andrea Colpani (Monza) finishes his beautiful individual effort with a superb strike from inside the box. Guillermo Ochoa is just a bystander as the ball flies into the bottom left corner. The score is 1:0.
6' Andrea Colpani (Monza) launches an inaccurate corner kick into the penalty area.

5' A sweet pass finds Jovane (Salernitana) on the edge of the box, and he drills the ball towards the bottom left corner. Michele Di Gregorio is almost caught out but pulls off a brilliant save at the last second.
4' Patrick Ciurria (Monza) found some space to play in a lofted pass, but he looks disappointed as none of his teammates managed to connect with it.
3' Samuele Vignato (Monza) sends in a pass which fails to reach any of his teammates.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
Monza will kick-off.
Luca Massimi will officiate today.
